name: norm
description: Build, migrate, debug, and test Bland v2 agents; create evaluations and analyze calls through the Bland API and coding workspace, with a task-indexed product wiki. v2-only; v1 requests belong to the bland plugin.

BLAND_API_KEY.title: Bland API key
BLAND_API_KEY.description: From app.bland.ai/settings/api-keys. Must belong to the org that owns the agents.

BLAND_API_URL.title: Bland API URL (optional)
BLAND_API_URL.description: Defaults to production (https://api.bland.ai). Only override for dev/staging.
